c.tagline: Sweden's easygoing second city - seafood, canals, cafes, and the west-coast archipelago.

taxi.fareNote: Sweden deregulated taxis, so fares vary sharply by company - check the price-comparison sticker (jamforpris) in the window before riding. Reputable firms include Taxi Goteborg, Taxi Kurir, and TaxiKurir; Uber and Bolt also operate.

emergency.note: 112 is the single European emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: The historic core 'within the moat', laced with canals, the Kungsportsavenyn gateway, shopping streets, and the main train station; central and walkable, the classic first-timer base.
An elegant 19th-century district of stone Renaissance-style buildings just off Kungsportsavenyn ('Avenyn'), packed with restaurants, bars, museums, and the Vasa church; lively dining and nightlife.
Gothenburg's oldest quarter, famous for cobbled Haga Nygata, wooden landshovdingehus, antique shops, and cosy cafes serving giant cinnamon buns; charming and browsable.
The trendy area around leafy Linnegatan and Jarntorget, full of bars, bistros, vintage shops, and Slottsskogen park on its doorstep; a favourite for going out and people-watching.
A bohemian, working-class harbour district west of the centre, known for artists, second-hand shops, food co-ops, and an easygoing creative vibe.

water.note: Tap water is excellent and safe everywhere.

transit.hours: Trams and buses run from about 5:00 AM to midnight, with night services (Flexlinjen / night buses) on weekends.
transit.note: Vasttrafik runs the network: Gothenburg has the largest tram system in Northern Europe (the backbone of city travel), plus buses and the Styrsobolaget archipelago ferries. One ticket covers all modes.
transit.pay: Buy tickets in the Vasttrafik To Go app (cheapest), from ticket machines, or tap a contactless bank card on board; there is no cash on trams or buses.

ferry: Stena Line ferries to Denmark and Germany
train: Gothenburg Central Station (SJ high-speed to Stockholm, regional Vasttag, Oresundstag to Malmo/Copenhagen)

transit.m: Flygbussarna airport coach to the city centre / Nils Ericson Terminal (~30 min, every 15-20 min)
Taxi to the city centre (~30-40 min)

tip.r: Service is included; rounding up or ~5-10% for good service is appreciated but never expected.
